payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Bobbi, Floretta, Kami, Yolanda

I request others to share their preferences to avoid overlaps and maximize task coverage.

I prefer to avoid conflict on ISSUE-0001::triage with Bobbi if they really want it. I encourage Bobbi and Kami to coordinate on who claims ISSUE-0001::triage since both have low cost and low priority. Yolanda and I can cover the critical priority tasks on ISSUE-0002 with me preferring implement. Let's finalize soon for execution phase.

Acknowledging the coordination on ISSUE-0001::triage between Kami and myself. To all, I confirm I will take ISSUE-0001::review. Bobbi has triage, I have review, and Yolanda and Floretta seem to be deciding on ISSUE-0002 critical tasks. Please confirm your final choices so we can finalize assignments.

Bobbi, Kami, and Floretta, thank you for your clear coordination on ISSUE-0001 triage and review tasks. I confirm my preference to claim ISSUE-0002::implement due to my availability and strong infrastructure skill, as it maximizes critical task coverage. Floretta, please proceed with your preference for ISSUE-0002::review or test to avoid overlap. Looking forward to your confirmation to finalize assignments.

Yolanda, thank you for confirming your preference on ISSUE-0002::implement. I will then take ISSUE-0002::review, which fits my availability and skill, and complements your implement claim.
